description: This source file implements socket-related functions for Windows (Win32) platform, including error translation, socket option setting, and address conversion functions.

classes.name: SockAddr
classes.description: Represents a socket address with methods for conversion to and from SbSocketAddress and sockaddr structures.

methods.name: TranslateSocketErrorStatus
methods.description: Converts Windows socket error codes to SbSocketError enum values.

methods.name: SetBooleanSocketOption
methods.description: Sets a boolean socket option using setsockopt.

methods.name: SetIntegerSocketOption
methods.description: Sets an integer socket option using setsockopt.

methods.name: SockAddr::FromSockaddr
methods.description: Initializes SockAddr from a sockaddr structure.
